content:
Here’s *The Iliad* in emojis:

👑💔👩 (King’s prize stolen—queen taken)
⚔️😡🏛️ (War erupts over honor)
🏹💀👨 (Hero Achilles rages—friend dies)
🛡️⚡🔥 (Gods pick sides—battle chaos)
🏃‍♂️🐴🏛️ (Trojan Horse trick? No—just rage!)
💀👨🏛️ (Hero dies, city doomed)
🔥🏛️😢 (Troy burns—end of an era)

*(Bonus: The real ending is "🏛️🔥😭" but the epic stops at Achilles’ grief.)*
